# focify.me

> focify.me is a personal, unofficial site that shows Filecoin Onchain Cloud working: a converter that stores a copy of any website, a gallery of demos, and a few tools that read live chain data. It is not affiliated with FilOz, the Filecoin Foundation or Protocol Labs. For authoritative documentation use the official docs linked below.

Filecoin Onchain Cloud stores data with storage providers who must prove, on a schedule, that they still hold it. Storage is paid for continuously through Filecoin Pay.

## This site

- [Convert a website](https://focify.me/): paste a URL and get a static copy stored on the calibration testnet, with a link that opens it.
- [Demos](https://focify.me/demos/): working demos grouped by use case, each linked to where it lives and credited to its author, with the date it was last checked.
- [Explore](https://focify.me/explore/): enter a payer address and see the data sets it pays for, their providers, sizes, status and funding. Read-only. Accepts ?network=mainnet|calibration&payer=0x...
- [Fund this archive](https://focify.me/archive/): a public photograph collection with its proof status, a funded-until date and a donate button, on the calibration testnet.
- [Time machine](https://focify.me/timemachine/): dated snapshots of websites stored on the calibration testnet, each opened by its content address.
- [For agents](https://focify.me/agents/): skills, command-line tools, an MCP server, the SDK and copy-paste prompts.
- [Guides](https://focify.me/guides/): short walkthroughs.
- [About](https://focify.me/about/): who runs the site and how it is hosted.

## Official documentation

- [Filecoin Onchain Cloud docs](https://docs.filecoin.cloud/): the authoritative reference.
- [Filecoin Onchain Cloud docs for language models](https://docs.filecoin.cloud/llms.txt): the docs' own llms.txt index.
- [Quick start with Filecoin Pin](https://docs.filecoin.cloud/getting-started/filecoin-pin/): install, fund and store a first file.
- [Synapse SDK](https://docs.filecoin.cloud/developer-guides/synapse/): the JavaScript SDK.
- [Filecoin docs for language models](https://docs.filecoin.io/llms.txt): the wider Filecoin documentation index.

## Tools for agents

- [Filecoin skills](https://github.com/filecoin-project/filecoin-skills): the official publish skill. Mainnet only.
- [FOC CLI](https://github.com/FIL-Builders/foc-cli): command line, agent skills and MCP mode. Calibration testnet by default.
- [FOC Storage MCP server](https://github.com/FIL-Builders/foc-storage-mcp): storage tools over the Model Context Protocol.
- [filecoin-pin](https://github.com/filecoin-project/filecoin-pin): the uploader used by this site.

## Data

- Chain figures on this site come from https://observer.yablu.net, an index of Filecoin Onchain Cloud contract events, and are labelled with the block they are as of.
